verses.en: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.
verses.pt: Aleluia! Louvai, vós servos do SENHOR, louvai o nome do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Praise Yah! Praise, you servants of Yahweh, praise Yahweh’s name.
verses.en_bbe: Let the Lord be praised. O you servants of the Lord, give praise to the name of the Lord.

verses.en: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.
verses.pt: Seja o nome do SENHOR bendito, desde agora para todo o sempre.
verses.en_web: Blessed be Yahweh’s name, from this time forward and forever more.
verses.en_bbe: Let blessing be on the name of the Lord, from this time and for ever.

verses.en: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD’S name is to be praised.
verses.pt: Desde o nascer do sol até o poente, seja louvado o nome do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: From the rising of the sun to the going down of the same, Yahweh’s name is to be praised.
verses.en_bbe: From the coming up of the sun to its going down, the Lord's name is to be praised.

verses.en: The LORD is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.
verses.pt: O SENHOR está elevado acima de todas as nações; e sua glória acima dos céus.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is high over all nations, and his glory is higher than the heavens.

verses.en: Who is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,
verses.pt: Quem é como o SENHOR nosso Deus? Ele que habita nas alturas,
verses.en_web: Who is like Yahweh, our God, who has his seat on high,
verses.en_bbe: Who is like the Lord our God, who is seated on high,

verses.en: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!
verses.pt: Que se abaixa para ver o que há nos céus e na terra;
verses.en_web: Who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth?
verses.en_bbe: Looking down on the heavens, and on the earth?

verses.en: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;
verses.pt: Que do levanta o pobre do pó da terra, e levanta o necessitado da sujeira;
verses.en_web: He raises up the poor out of the dust. Lifts up the needy from the ash heap;
verses.en_bbe: He takes the poor man out of the dust, lifting him up from his low position;

verses.en: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
verses.pt: Para fazê-lo sentar com os príncipes, com os príncipes de seu povo;
verses.en_web: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
verses.en_bbe: To give him a place among the rulers, even with the rulers of his people.

verses.en: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.pt: Que faz a estéril habitar em família, como alegre mãe de filhos. Aleluia!
verses.en_web: He settles the barren woman in her home, as a joyful mother of children. Praise Yah!
verses.en_bbe: He gives the unfertile woman a family, making her a happy mother of children. Give praise to the Lord.
